scope: train-only causal expanding conflict-component diagnostic on heldout dancetrack0012; no dev/gate frames
claim: Rank-based anonymous proposal competition can form a bounded protected conflict component without exact pair membership, then expand it causally while a joint one-to-one motion bank carries identity through the unresolved window.
oracle_use: GT is used only to mine/score hard and safe rows and to initialize the two clean pre-event protected boxes. Component formation, proposal pools, expansion, and the hypothesis bank use only causal detector boxes and public protected track state.

settings.initial_component: connected tracks sharing any top-2 proposal by IoU
settings.expansion: add outside protected tracks whose top-2 proposal set intersects the current anonymous bundle pool
settings.transition_cost: sum squared constant-velocity center residual normalized by previous box width/height
settings.publication: none for unresolved component members during the deferred window
